response.reason: Computing sqrt(1+x*x)-1 in FP32 suffers catastrophic cancellation for small x: for x~1e-3, rho~5e-7 but the FP32 sqrt/subtract introduces absolute error up to ~1.2e-7 (one ulp of 1.0), far exceeding the 1e-8 + 1e-5*rho tolerance (the reference uses the cancellation-free rational form x^2/(sqrt(1+x^2)+1)).
